scene_description: Two children are riding a ride at an amusement park. They are seated in a green car and holding onto a yellow bar. A Ferris wheel is visible in the background along with trees and colorful ride structures.

questions.question: What color is the bar the children are holding?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the bar in front of the children's hands.

questions.question: Who is sitting in the ride?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the people sitting in the green car.

questions.question: What color is the seat the children are sitting in?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the seat behind and around the children.

questions.question: Where are the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big wheel and colorful rides in the background.

questions.question: What big ride can you see in the background?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the tall round structure behind the children.
